scenes.name: TWO INPUTS
lines: Seventeen is one zero zero zero one in binary. Nine has only two zeros between its ones.
17 的二进制是 10001；9 的两个 1 之间只有两个零。
That missing zero decides whether an enormous factorial quotient is odd or even.
少一个零，竟能决定一个庞大阶乘商的奇偶性。
Our quotient uses factorials, the products from one up to each displayed argument.
这里的阶乘，就是从 1 乘到所标出的整数。

scenes.name: THE SPACING RULE
lines: Ma and Zhang prove that the quotient is a natural number, odd exactly when every pair of ones is at least four positions apart.
Ma 与 Zhang 证明，这个商是自然数，且为奇数恰好要求每两个 1 至少相距四位。
Three intervening zeros are enough. Seventeen qualifies; nine does not.
中间至少三个零即可；17 满足，9 不满足。
Zero qualifies too: it has no occupied positions, and its quotient is one. Bala posed the parity question in twenty twenty six.
零也满足条件：它没有占据位置，商等于 1。Bala 于 2026 年提出这个奇偶问题。

scenes.name: COUNT TWOS
lines: To test oddness, count factors of two in the numerator, then subtract those in the denominator.
判断奇偶性，只需数分子的因子 2，再减去分母的因子 2。
Multiples of two count once, multiples of four again, and multiples of eight again. This gives a sum of floor differences.
2 的倍数计一次，4 的倍数再计一次，8 的倍数继续计；于是得到取整差的和。
Each floor difference is zero or one. The quotient is an integer because no prime is left in its reduced denominator.
每个取整差都是零或一；对所有素数都非负，约分后分母就没有素数，所以商是整数。
It is odd exactly when every binary summand is zero. A positive summand cannot be cancelled.
它是奇数，恰好要求每个二进制项都为零；正的项无法被抵消。

scenes.name: WHY FOUR POSITIONS
lines: With four-position spacing, the lower bits contribute less than one fifteenth of the highest occupied bit.
四位间距使低位尾部小于最高占据位的十五分之一。
The bound comes from one sixteenth plus one over sixteen squared, and so on. There are only finitely many bits, so the inequality is strict.
这个界来自十六分之一、十六平方分之一等的几何和；位数有限，所以是严格不等式。
At every binary suffix, this small tail keeps the floor difference at zero. That proves the odd direction.
对每个二进制后缀，这个小尾部都让取整差保持为零，证明了奇数方向。

scenes.name: THE FIRST SHORT GAP
lines: Now choose the first short gap, reading from low bits to high bits. The lower tail still obeys the bound.
现在从低位往高位找第一对过近的 1；更低的尾部仍满足刚才的界。
A gap of one, two, or three positions forces a floor difference of one. Every other term is nonnegative, so the quotient is even.
距离为一、二或三位时，都强制出现取整差 1；其余项非负，所以商是偶数。
For nine, the suffix fraction is nine sixteenths. For seventeen, seventeen thirty seconds gives zero instead.
对 9，后缀小数是十六分之九；对 17，三十二分之十七则给出零。

scenes.name: A SHORT RULE
lines: The result turns a huge factorial calculation into a short rule on input digits. The proof explains why the rule works.
这个结果把巨大的阶乘计算化成查看输入数字的短规则；证明解释了规则为何成立。
The paper also derives counting recursions, bitwise identities, and divisibility results for a second factorial quotient.
原文还推导计数递推、按位恒等式，以及另一个阶乘商的整除结果。
Read the bilingual explanation for the complete statements, proofs, and earlier work.
完整陈述、证明与前人工作，见双语解读。
